items.text: On Monday, we hosted women veterans from across #FL03 to talk about everything on their minds, from VA services and healthcare to the perception of women in the military. Check out the recap below and stay tuned for more announcements about upcoming roundtables. https://t.co/fRBlcv03IB

While I traveled back home yesterday afternoon, #TeamKat celebrated the opening of Anodyne Pain and Wellness Center in Ocala. With the goal of treating pain holistically without opioids, Anodyne’s team is excited to continue supporting the health and well-being of #FL03. https://t.co/oJCBMbUYeR

Had a great meeting with Craig Mikell yesterday in our Gainesville office, discussing the rising prices of property insurance in Florida and the future of Florida homeownership. https://t.co/mHWRSjhUuP

While I was in D.C. his week, #TeamKat toured Fidelity Manufacturing in Ocala. The company offers large impact and UL 2200 Certified Enclosure Construction for engines, large generator enclosures, and fuel tanks. Many of the products are used at local hospitals and data centers. https://t.co/2uYTxPMBj7

.@RepAlLawsonJr and I led a letter with our Florida colleagues to the @EPA about the approval of Vismax, a treatment for citrus greening disease that threatens Florida citrus crops. 

Read more: https://t.co/iW3G67o1yt https://t.co/KyPAnz7riW

Without EPA approval of Vismax, the citrus industry will experience crippling losses at the hands of infected trees, which is why we need to make this safe and effective treatment readily available to our citrus producers. 

https://t.co/jDkRH08tOW
